name: Luv Kush
description:
Luv Kush is an Indian television series created, written, produced, and directed by Ramanand Sagar. It is a follow-up to Sagar's highly successful Ramayan, featuring mostly the same cast and production crew.

Luv Kush covers the last book, the "Uttar Kand," of the ancient Indian epic Ramayana, following Ram's coronation, especially focusing on his children Luv and Kush.

videos.title: Episode 01
videos.overview: Episode 1:  Shri Ram takes oath after coronation. Sita gifts jewels to Hanuman. Hanuman asks to be blessed with honor to be Shri Ram's devotee.

videos.title: Episode 02
videos.overview: Episode 2:  Shri Ram goes to the city in a procession. Shri Ram pay obeisance to the statues of his ancestors and promises to follow their traditions  Manthra repents for having instigated Kaykai to send Shri Ram to forest.

videos.title: Episode 03
videos.overview: Episode 3:  Brahma sends Narad to Valmiki. Garud goes to Shiva to know about Shri Ram and then goes to meet Bhushandi - the Crow.

videos.title: Episode 04
videos.overview: Episode 4: Narad conveys Brahma's request to Valmiki. Killing of Kraunch inspires Valmiki to say the first verse.

videos.title: Episode 05
videos.overview: Episode 5: Brahma inspires Valmiki to compose Ramayan. Shri Ram's daily life. Mothers ask permission to retire.

videos.title: Episode 06
videos.overview: Episode 6: Shri Ram meets with his brothers. Detectives brief Shri Ram. Rishi meets Shri Ram.

videos.title: Episode 07
videos.overview: Episode 7:  Rishis arrive. Bhushandi - the Crow narrates Shri Ram's childhood to Garud.

videos.title: Episode 08
videos.overview: Episode 8: Shri Ram welcomes Rishis. Detectives brief Shri Ram

videos.title: Episode 09
videos.overview: Episode 9: Sita is surprised to see Shri Ram in disguise. Shri Ram goes out in disguise to meet the villagers. Sita inquires from Ram.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Episode 10: Shri Ram seeks guidance from Guru Vashishth. Sita inquires reason for Shri Ram's anxiety.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Episode 11: Shri Ram goes before the statues of his ancestors. Sita talks with Shri Ram talk about his anxiety.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Episode 12: Sita is taken to forest. Valmiki welcomes Sita. Shri Ram sleeps on the bed of grass in his palace.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Episode 13: Sita remembers the sweetness of time spent with Shri Ram. Shri Ram's daily routine in absence of Sita. Valmiki's guidance to Sita. King Janak's visit to Ayodhya.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Episode 14: King Janak's conversation with Shri Ram.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Episode 15: Guru Vashishth permits Shri Ram to visit Mithila. Shri Ram meets Sita's mother. Janak's spiritual advice to Shri Ram.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Episode 16: Sumantra's revelations to Lakshman. Prediction by Sage Durvasa. Valmiki's advaice to Sita.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Episode 17: Sage Chyavan in Shri Ram's court. Shri Ram orders to kill Lavanasur. Secret weapon given to Shatrughana.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Episode 18: Shatrughana departs with army. Shatrughana stays in Valmiki's Ashram where Luv-Kush are born. Luv-Kush blessed by Shatrughana.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Episode 19: Shatrughana departs for Mathura. Lavanasur in his court.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Episode 20: Shatrughana meets Sage Chyavan. The story of war between Lavanasur and Mandhata.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Episode 21: Lavanasur worships the Trishul. Shatraghana kills Lavanasur. Shatrughana becomes King of Mathura.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Episode 22: Victory celebration in Ayodhya. Sita sings the lullaby. Sita and Valmiki discuss the benefit of Astrology.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Episode 23: Under water pennance by Sage Agustya. Agustya blesses Shri Ram and Lakshman.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Episode 24: The childhood of Luv-Kush. Valmiki teaches the use of arms. Sita teaches her children.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview:
Episode 25: Education of Luv-Kush. Physical labor, meditation and universal brotherhood. Yagyopavit ceremony of Luv-Kush.

.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Episode 26: Luv-Kush sing Ramayan. Luv reacts to the insutice of Shri Ram. Shri Ram decides to perform Ashwameh yagna.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Episode 27: Proposal of second marriage of Shri Ram. Reaction of Sita. Shri Ram refuses to marry again.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Episode 28: Proposal to have golden statue of Sita. Sita repents.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Episode 29: Luv-Kush receive divine weapons. Luv-Kush ask Sita about their father.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Episode 30: Ashwamedh Yagna begins. Shatrughana leaves for conquest of world.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Episode 31: Luv-Kush catch the sacred horse of the yagna.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Episode 32: Shatrughana defeated by Luv-Kush. Shri Ram sends Lakshman for the battle.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Episode 33: Lakshman defeated. Bharat and Sugriv arrive at the battlefield. Hanuman talks to Luv-Kush.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Episode 34: Bharat and Sugriv are wounded. Shri Ram himself comes to the battlefield.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Episode 35: Shri Ram and Luv-Kush face each other. Valmiki intervenes. Sita reveals to Luv-Kush that Shri Ram is their father. Luv-Kush sing in Ayodhya streets.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Episode 36: Luv-Kush meet Shri Ram. Luv-Kush come to the Royal Court.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Episode 37: Luv-Kush narrate Ramayan in the Court. Shri Ram wants Sita to come to the Royal court. Sita comes to Shri Ram's Court.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Episode 38: Sita takes the vow and leaves the world with Mother Earth.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Episode 39: Luv-Kush received in the palace. Shri Ram decides to leave the world. Shri Ram adopts his original form of Vishnu and goes to his divine abode.
